transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to get the sustainment skills validation schedule finalized today. We've got four modules to schedule across four training blocks: vehicle recovery procedures, load-planning procedures, radio-setup procedures, and heat-injury response. Before I can publish the final schedule, I need a written coordination control for each module. Let's hear from each of you on your training requirements and any changes we need to account for. S-3, let's start with you.

I'll get my written coordination control submitted for load-planning procedures to reflect this requirement. I'll defer to the other staff principals on any changes to their respective modules.
